license: Dataset CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 per author's README; raw data and trained text models kept outside Git
selection: Fit text features on official train only. Select candidate by macro-F1 on official dev records whose normalized input text is absent from train. Freeze classifier before fetching test gold. Publish all candidate validation scores; no post-test tuning.
evaluation: Official test accuracy, macro-F1 on fixed 148 train labels, kappa, top3; also exact-text-unseen stratum and source user_id overlap counts without assuming this ID denotes a patient. Evaluate frozen existing graph on same texts. Supplementary TCMEval-SDT transfer is exploratory because its baseline scores were already observed, and label ontology mismatch remains.
limits: Computational retrospective benchmark, not clinical deployment validation
TF-IDF classifiers are supervised baselines, not LLMs or KAN/PPO
No claim that this reproduces DMease's original 50-patient study
